acceptance_criteria: An operator can create, search, select, edit, and transition a release using only repository-defined statuses.
A release cannot move to ready while required gates are uncleared or blocking open risks remain.
Desktop and mobile views expose title, version, status, gate clearance, and open risk counts without horizontal overflow.
capabilities.name: Release portfolio and lifecycle control

acceptance_criteria: An operator can add a required gate and update it through pending, passed, failed, or waived states.
Gate actions preserve selected release context and immediately update gate clearance counts.
Invalid gate transitions return a readable conflict without losing the pending form state.
capabilities.name: Delivery gate management

acceptance_criteria: An operator can add low, medium, high, or critical risks and mark whether each risk blocks readiness.
Open blocking risks prevent ready status until they are closed, accepted, or mitigated according to the domain rules.
Risk cards expose severity, blocking status, and allowed next actions without requiring source-code knowledge.
capabilities.name: Risk register and mitigation control

acceptance_criteria: The selected release audit view shows ordered events for release, gate, and risk actions.
The all-releases audit mode reads the repository API and does not require mutation authorization.
Audit entries expose prior and new status so final review can reconstruct the delivery path.
capabilities.name: Append-only audit inspection

acceptance_criteria: Read-only health, release, and audit views load locally without a bearer token.
Mutation forms surface unauthorized responses and preserve operator context.
Security headers, loopback binding, bounded request bodies, and token redaction are verified by tests and smoke evidence.
capabilities.name: Local runtime safety boundary
